description: This file defines the interface IPCReceiverHandler, which declares methods for handling inter-process communication (IPC) requests, both marshaled and direct, in a Java project. It includes method signatures for processing remote requests with message payloads and local requests with input/output objects.

classes.name: IPCReceiverHandler
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for handling IPC requests, including marshaled and direct processing methods.

methods.name: handleMarshaledRequest
methods.description: Processes an IPC request received with marshaled message data encapsulated in an IPCMessage object.

methods.name: handleDirectRequest
methods.description: Processes an IPC request within the same process using message code and input/output objects without marshaling.
